entities.name: Expose the kernel reference interpreter as a command
entities.summary: Read one frozen kernel JSON byte stream and emit one canonical reference-interpreter observation through a Bun and Node process boundary.

acceptance: One file or stdin byte stream produces one canonical kernel-run observation
Returned and suspended observations are distinguished from rejection and inconclusion by exit status
Invocation and host I/O failures never masquerade as semantic observations
Bun and Node emit byte-identical stdout
The command does not import or claim agreement with the bytecode backend

relations.summary: The command consumes the frozen agent-facing kernel bytes without reparsing them.
The accepted reference interpreter remains the sole execution authority.
Adds a stateless process adapter around the executable kernel.
